desc: The Springfield Armory Model 2020 Heatseeker is a chassis-based rifle crafted for shooters who demand bolt-action precision and AR-style modularity in one uncompromising platform. Built on their custom-grade Model 2020 action with dual locking lugs, a fluted bolt, and EDM raceways, it delivers surgical accuracy with a .75 MOA guarantee. Housed in the Sharps Bros Heatseeker Chassis with a B5 Systems Precision Stock and Pistol Grip, it offers additional versatility and ergonomic control. Finished in rugged Coyote Brown Cerakote and equipped with a Triggertech Field Trigger, the Heatseeker chambered in .308 Winchester is ready for chasing game or stacking rounds on target.
